text:
alex: Planning to enable catalog:v3.1 tomorrow in the 07:00-09:00 UTC change window. Need a short sign-off on staged ramp, pin exclusions, and the rollback gate.
maya: Suggest ramp 3% -> 12% -> 30% over 25m, hold for 20m verification. Exclude pinned customer routes from the hedge.
jorge: Ops: hard rollback if error rate +0.5% absolute for 3m OR p95 +40% for 10m. Soft pause at p95 +15%. Drain old variant for 20m after shift.
deploybot: preflight: 
```nchecks: [config-valid, artifacts, telemetry, slot-check]
result: config-valid:ok, artifacts:ok, telemetry:warning (no smoke-set in region), slot-check:ok
```
deploybot: telemetry warning must be acknowledged or fixed. Proceeding without smoke-set increases risk of silent regressions.
maya: Product will drop a 20-sample smoke prompt set by 18:00 today; if not present, we enable synthetic smoke and stricter alerts.
ops-oncall: I'll be on-call and ready to run rollback manually. Recommend a short live-runbook item: who flips the switch and when.
alex: Add runbook steps: 1) watch regression job, 2) on soft-pause hold progression and run quick bisect, 3) if hard threshold hit, toggle enable=false and drain.
jorge: Confirmed. If EU region breaches SLO, shift traffic to US until resolved.
maya: Draft release note: "Enable v3.1 catalog (phased roll, pinned routes excluded). Watch for latency regressions on quant path."
alex: Approving with acknowledged telemetry warning. Scheduling deploybot to enable at 1763415600 (07:00 UTC). I'll post 30m before start in #releases. :white_check_mark:
